item.title: Moderna and Merck Announce Phase 3 INTerpath-001 Trial of Intismeran Autogene Met Its Primary Endpoint
item.description: CAMBRIDGE, Mass. -- Moderna, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRNA) and Merck (NYSE: MRK) today announced that the trial met its primary endpoint of recurrence-free survival.

item.title: Berkshire Hathaway to make additional $330 million investment in Bending Spoons
item.description: MILAN -- Bending Spoons S.p.A. (Nasdaq: BSP) announced a private placement of 10,000,000 ordinary shares to Berkshire Hathaway at $33.00 per share.
